explication: Helpdesk.ai is a multi-tenant AI helpdesk with web and Android clients. Users sign in, create or track tickets, and receive AI-assisted triage and resolution; company and master admins manage tickets, users, and tenant operations. The backend provides ticket APIs and AI services, while Supabase supports identity, ticket data, and realtime updates. The README documents classification, entity extraction, duplicate detection, OCR, and generative resolution. Some frontend routes and backend wiring were not sampled, so uncertain connections are omitted.
